name: dashboard
title: Dashboard
description: The frosted shell, a page header, headline figures in one strip, an orders chart with a 7, 30 and 90 day switch, and the list-page table.

name: inbox
title: Inbox
description: A mail-style app in three resizable panes: folders, the message list with search and an unread switch, and the open message with a reply box.

name: data-table
title: Data table (tasks)
description: Tasks with one full-width search, status and priority dropdowns, row selection with select-all, a bulk actions bar and centred pagination.

name: settings
title: Settings
description: A section nav, field groups in one frosted panel, notification switches and a Danger zone whose actions confirm with a typed phrase.

name: sidebar-icon
title: Sidebar: collapsible icon rail
description: The sidebar folds to an icon rail from the top bar, and the choice is remembered.

name: sidebar-inset
title: Sidebar: inset
description: The page set into one frosted sheet inside the main area, with a secondary nav across its top.

name: header-only
title: Header only
description: No sidebar: logo, a short nav and the profile in one frosted top bar, the page full width below.

name: auth-login
title: Sign in with MFA
description: Password, then the authenticator code, with authenticator setup when a device is lost. Brand bar above, security note below.

name: auth-signup
title: Create an account
description: Name, work email, a password and the terms, in one card.

name: auth-otp
title: Email code
description: A six-digit code sent by email, with resend.

name: auth-mfa-setup
title: Set up an authenticator
description: Scan a QR code or type the key, then confirm with the first code.

name: auth-reset
title: Reset password
description: Ask for the email and send a reset link.

name: auth-check-email
title: Check your email
description: After a magic link or reset: what to do next, with resend.
